# SuperConnectorResult { #dyf.SuperConnectorResult }

```python
SuperConnectorResult(
    indices,
    global_centrality,
    local_centrality,
    quadrant,
    global_threshold,
    local_threshold,
)
```

Result of finding super connectors in an embedding space.

Super connectors are points with high centrality in both global and local
bridge networks - they connect major semantic regions AND facets within
dense clusters. They represent ~0.1% of typical corpora but provide
disproportionate coverage as RAG anchors.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name              | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                             |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| indices           | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Array of super connector point indices                                                                                  |
| global_centrality | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Global bridge centrality for all points (0 = non-bridge)                                                                |
| local_centrality  | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Local (facet) bridge centrality for all points                                                                          |
| quadrant          | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Category label for each point ('Regular', 'Minor Bridge',       'Cross-Domain', 'Domain Specialist', 'Super Connector') |
| global_threshold  | [float](`float`)                         | Threshold used for "high" global centrality                                                                             |
| local_threshold   | [float](`float`)                         | Threshold used for "high" local centrality                                                                              |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [summary](#dyf.SuperConnectorResult.summary) | Return a summary string of the super connector distribution. |

### summary { #dyf.SuperConnectorResult.summary }

```python
SuperConnectorResult.summary()
```

Return a summary string of the super connector distribution.
